title: Add project Engram settings UI and verification
outcome: Operators must configure project-scoped Engram integration through TermAl UI instead of hand-crafting a secret-bearing PATCH. Add a project settings Engram tab with enabled toggle, binary/home inputs with defaults, masked write-only grant input, Verify using backend doctor plus authority validation, fail-closed Save through the existing PATCH, and a project status line.
acceptance: Project settings exposes an Engram tab; defaults are engram on PATH and %USERPROFILE%\\.engram; the work-authority grant is masked and never rendered back or logged; Verify surfaces project_id, database, required_assurance, healthy, installed/subject/valid-until/revoked; Save is refused until verification succeeds and uses the existing project Engram PATCH; project UI shows enabled and last verification result; focused tests, tsc, full Vitest, and UI production build pass.
